contentText: In tonight's edition, 16 students lose their lives as fire tears through a boarding school in central Kenya. Also, 28th May is World Hunger Day, and it comes as many farmers and families across the continent and around the world are trying to navigate choppy waters caused by  the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. It's been 10 years since Chadian dictator Hissen Habre was found guilty of horrific human rights abuses by an international tribunal in Senegal.
